title: The cactus
premise: Marcus waits at the station with sunflowers and a cactus; she tells him he is going nowhere and leaves with a show-off. Two years later he has the usual table at the best restaurant in town, and he tells the show-off exactly how in four steps.

shots.image_prompt: medium close shot, a bright busy train station concourse with a big glass roof, bright midday light pouring through the glass roof, {marcus}, in a too-big brown corduroy jacket over a striped shirt, up on his toes waving a big bunch of sunflowers over his head with one hand and hugging a tiny potted cactus with a red bow against his chest with the other, a huge hopeful grin that is just starting to falter, eyes fixed on someone off camera, mouth open mid-call. Vertical composition, no text anywhere in the image.
shots.motion_prompt: Marcus bounces on his toes waving the sunflowers and his mouth moves as he calls her name, then his grin wobbles as he sees who is with her. Push-in on his faltering smile.
shots.vo_line: Jess? Over here!
shots.speaker: marcus

shots.image_prompt: medium two shot, a bright busy train station concourse with a big glass roof, bright midday light pouring through the glass roof, {jess}, in a yellow summer dress with a denim jacket, arm in arm with Tyler and slowing to a stop, head tilted, a soft pained smile, eyebrows pinched with pity, mouth open mid-sentence; {tyler}, in a shiny silver bomber jacket with mirrored sunglasses pushed up in his hair, chewing gum beside her and looking the other way, bored. shots.motion_prompt: Jess slows down and squeezes Tyler's arm, her mouth moving as she says it gently; Tyler blows a gum bubble and looks around. Slow push-in on her kind, sorry face.

shots.speaker: jess
